notes.title: NITE Team 4 hacks out of the early access firewall today
notes.notes:
Hacking games fall into two main categories – fanciful Hollywood-style UI showcases like Uplink, or grittier, more code-based ones like Exapunks. NITE Team 4 left early access today and looks like it straddles that divide. Developed by Alice & Smith (nothing to do with our crew, but a studio that John is rather fond of) it’s a game of military hacking and espionage with serious command-line stuff wrapped in some lovely-looking interfaces. Just going on looks alone, it’s come a long way since its minimalist 2016 demo – see a trailer below.

notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/8cdce2c59ca24d17f532b945772adb40b50abbcf.jpg[/img]

 
[b]Dreamers, it’s finally here![/b]
Enter the dream world of Ahnayro, where shadowy figures, terror, and the only possibility of salvation all lurk. Strange presences weave in and out of your mind as you journey into the darkest shadows of your dreams. Confront inner demons and lurking evils as you seek the truth, a truth found in between two worlds: the waking and the dreaming.


We’ve worked hard for over a year now on adding the complete depth and complexity that the dream world Ahnayro deserves. The dream fragment riddles act as rabbit holes, inviting you deeper into the mysteries of the dream world, while the narrative, soundtrack, and images act as breadcrumbs, showing you that you’re on the right path as you progress along your investigation.


We have made changes to Table 1 and Table 2 to deepen the immersion and to further connect the complexity of the puzzles with the overarching narrative. Join the dreamer as she navigates her dreams and tries to save herself from her own inner turmoil and illness.


As before, don’t forget to [url=https://forums.aliceandsmith.com/]visit us on the forums[/url] to meet your fellow oneironauts and to discuss what you see beyond the veil of reality.

[h1]Hi everyone! I would like to take the time to give an update on the current projects at Alice and Smith. [/h1]

[b]It’s been a year since we launched The Black Watchmen[/b] and if you read the [url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/archive/uploads/Almanac-2016-WebEdition.pdf] Almanac[/url], you know that a lot has happened in the last 12 months. For me, it was by far the most exciting year as a puppet master and a game developer. We have launched a second (and soon a third) game, nearly doubled the size of our community and successfully kidnapped one of our players. It has been a thrill ride.

As we look forward to the Fall months, there [b]is a lot on the horizon.[/b] We are set to release the [b]full version of Ahnayro[/b] at the end of September, expand [b]NITE Team 4[/b] and further broaden the universe of The Black Watchmen.


[h1]-- THE BLACK WATCHMEN [/h1]
Many of you are eager for the announcement of Season 3, and we don’t blame you! We are excited about the story we want to tell, however [b]before we officially announce the launch date of a new season[/b], we believe we need to [b]improve the core quality of the game and define how we must evolve the ARG experience to the next level[/b]. Mother Russia was an opportunity to test all that we had learned over the past year:


-The live event was a great experience for both us and the community. While there were many amazing moments (code book, recon, etc…), the one that stands out for me as a puppet master is the final live stream on Twitch. I see a lot of untapped potential in this, and I want us to explore it more.

-Mother Russia allowed us to increase the level of role playing content within a mission set with the Msika Archive, an in-depth lore document. We want to test similar deeper lore artifacts and see how we can better balanced it with the puzzle and the ARG components.

-Mother Russia had a lot of lore and content to explore, but was a little short on the number of puzzles. I think we could increase the amount of puzzles and their challenge without having any impact on the quality or the cost of the DLC.

Therefore, we see three next steps for The Black Watchmen: A dedicated live event hub, a new DLC that you will vote on and a new hint mechanic.


[h1]1. DEDICATED LIVE EVENT HUB[/h1]
We have been attempting to centralize the live event experience in a core hub for a long time, and the response to the stream at the end of Operation SILVERSPEAR was so positive that we decided to create the [b]Coordination & Operations Management (COM) Division[/b]. The COM Division website hub will be open during a live event and will be personalized (using your in-game agent login) for an optimal browser and mobile experience (aka field work).

The hub will feature:

-Twitch stream and live chat
-Collective progression of the event so far
-Rewards and achievement you have completed
-Time and date in UTC (no more shit i missed it)
-Agent participation, which could be organized by class, groups, territory or blood type
-Deeper interaction with Dispatch through radar monitoring, interactive maps, strategic deployment, resources management, etc...
-Links to Archive documents about the current event
-Mobile support to submit field intel

[url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/Images/01-COM-Division.jpg] (!) PREVIEW: (VERY EARLY!) wireframe of the COM Division hub	[/url]

-5 new missions (with Video Cutscenes)
-Around 25 puzzles (+40% over Mother Russia)
-A new live event
-Cost of 5$
-Target Launch Date - End of October, early November


[h1]3. HINT MECHANIC[/h1]
Finally, we want to provide a large quality of life improvement for the agents playing Season 1 and Season 2. For this, we will introduce the [b]Surveillance and Information Management (SIM) Division[/b]. Accessible within the game, it will feature multiple hints broken down by puzzle. The SIM Division is actually relying on curated Intel from agents; integrating hints from the forums thread into the client. Agents who contributed to the hints will be credited. We encourage agents to continue contributing hint in the forums, SIM Division will review this intel and use it to expand our global help system.


[url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/Images/02-SIM-Division.jpg] (!) PREVIEW: (VERY EARLY!) wireframe of the SIM Division	[/url]


[h1]-- AHNAYRO [/h1]
Ahnayro continues to evolve and grow. It has already helped us bring 976 new players to the community in Early Access alone but more impressive; [b]63% of Ahnayro players bought a copy of The Black Watchmen[/b]. By the end of the year, we hope to bring an additional 2000 players to the community.

Table 2 is about to be launched and we plan for an official release at the end of September. A special quest line will also be unlockable only by Black Watchmen “Scientist” Class.


[url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/Images/03-Ahnayro-Table2.png] (!) PREVIEW: Dream fragment from Table 2	[/url]


[h1]-- NITE Team 4[/h1]
We will need your help to determine the future of NITE Team 4. At the moment, we have the funds to deliver a project at the scale of Ahnayro, reaching out to a different audience (hacker experience) and helping us expand The Black Watchmen universe. [b]But we have a larger vision for NITE Team 4[/b]. We believe it can span into a much bigger project, something along the lines of The Black Watchmen Season 1. Including advanced mechanics, narrative, voice actors, content and its own original soundtrack.


[url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/Images/04-NT4-Kickstarter.png] (!) PREVIEW: NT4 Kickstarter Promo	[/url]

We decided to turn to Kickstarter to see if there is interest in a [b]“Hacker Experience”[/b] game like NT4. If successful, this will also bring visibility and new players to the Black Watchmen universe. Like in Ahnayro, we also plan to have a NITE Team 4 special quest line unlockable only by Black Watchmen “Cybertech” Class. To be clear: the Kickstarter funding will simply define how far we can push NITE Team 4 in terms of mechanics and content.

The Kickstarter for NITE Team 4 will go live in the next two weeks. [b]With your support, we can make this game better![/b]


[h1]-- CONCLUSION[/h1]
Now that Mother Russia madness is over, we are back and ready to work! Looking forward to
your feedback on NITE Team 4, Ahnayro and The Black Watchmen

- Anashel

notes.title: Operation SILVERSPEAR
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wobtuyy.jpg[/img]

[h1]Action Required[/h1]

Work with NITE Team 4 to create a comprehensive monitoring network of postal offices around the world to counteract ongoing biological attacks.

[h1]Background[/h1]

So far today, Division 66 has been alerted of 54 biological attacks across the globe. All attacks have been carried out in a similar fashion - letters, delivered in the mail, containing an unknown fast-acting pathogen [Codenamed PERUN] which kills its host shortly after exposure. It is in a weaponized powder form and extremely lethal. An average of 5.3 people were infected by each letter, PERUN’s mortality rate is nearly 80%. It is not highly contagious - it appears to be focused on area of effect neutralization rather than uncontrolled propagation.

Teams dispatched to the incident sites reported trace levels of rupture radiation from the letter and victims. Analysis of this phenomenon is ongoing, but it may be contributing to the lethality of the pathogen.

[h1]Updates[/h1]

All letter used in the attacks share a similar profile:
- Delivered by mail to businesses during regular hours
- Contained Russian postage
- Marked Urgent
- Contained blank paper and a pathogen in weaponized powder form
 
All letters contained an untraceable mail ID tracking tag, suggesting the letters were injected into the mail system throughout the Russian territories. The size and scope of the organization behind the attacks is unknown at this time. We must assume we are dealing with a sophisticated group. 

The pattern of the campaign suggests this is not a terrorist attack, but may instead be series of targeted assassinations or a large scale biological weapons test. At its current rate, a sustained campaign could reach a death toll of more than 1200 by the end of the week unless an early detection network is established. 

[h1]Instructions[/h1]

All agents must work to gather recon photos of post office branches along with screencaptures showing wifi networks to create a comprehensive monitoring system of the world’s postal systems. Field Intelligence gathered on [b]ANY city[/b], anywhere in the world will be added to the surveillance network. Important details of the field work, including safety directives, can be found here: [url=http://archive.blackwatchmen.com/search/6F4FA7]Archive 6F4FA7[/url]
[list][*]The [url=http://intrusion.blackwatchmen.com/]Global Alert Network map[/url] will be updated as the network increases in strength. 
[*]A broader Global Alert Network will allow more infected letters to be detected early and minimize casualties.[/list]

NITE Team 4 will use the information submitted by field agents to start an intrusion operation in the postal offices. They will then be automating scans to create an early detection and surveillance network. 
[list][*]Monitor the [url=https://kiwiirc.com/client/irc.blackwatchmen.com/division66]IRC[/url] and the [url=http://forums.blackwatchmen.com/index.php?forums/ongoing-missions.17/]Forums[/url] for further details.[/list]

notes.title: The Bleeding Edges: Ahnayro The Dream World
notes.notes:
The Bleeding Edges are a series of articles on games that blur reality and fiction.

Oh it feels like home. So many spin-offs deep it must be getting dizzy, Ahnayro: The Dream World [official site] is a spin-off from The Black Watchmen, itself a spin-off from The Secret World. But, importantly, you need have heard of neither – let alone played them – to fully embrace this research-based puzzle game. (Of course, you should play both games, as they’re great, and most especially Watchmen if you’re into mystery games.) This early alpha version of Ahnayro takes a slightly different tack, stripping away the fiction of playing an agent in a conspiratorial organisation, and instead presenting far more overt puzzles in a dream-logic world. Within minutes of starting (and I’m not exaggerating how quickly I encountered all this), I was learning about the life of Virginia Woolf, the origins of Great Ormond Street, how to read electronic diagrams, 18th century gardeners and the role of thimbles in Peter Pan.

notes.notes:
The Bleeding Edges are a series of articles on games that blur reality and fiction.

There was once a wonderful thing on the internet: The Stone. It was when we were all tiny babies (1997), and Wikipedia was still a twinkle in Jimmy Wales’s twinkly eye. You got access to it by buying a physical object, a small stone pendant, and with the code imprinted upon it delved into a creepy online world of conspiracy and truth. The game was ostensibly a puzzle game, but you played it via search engines, and even real life actual research. It was wonderful while it lived, and slightly clumsily lives on here. I constantly seek something else like it. The Black Watchmen [official site] – a tangential spin-off from The Secret World – while delivered more in the style of the more recent ARGs, certainly picks up some of its themes.

notes.title: Operation DARKAVALON - Debriefing
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qtoZa27.jpg[/img]

[h1]AGENTS,[/h1]

 Operation [b]DARKAVALON[/b] resulted [b]in the death of Agent MidDipper.[/b] During a raid on the Chinese Consulate General in Vancouver, the strike team was not able to recover the agent in their holding room. The only piece of evidence the strike team was able to extract was an audio recording of their final moments. We strongly suspect SIGIL was behind this operation against our agents and commend the Green Level agent on their efforts to return Agent MidDipper. We will strike back hard against SIGIL for what they have done, this will not be forgiven.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FebtNs1.jpg[/img]}

Shortly after the exploit on the consulate employees computer, Agent Greenstarfanatic was intercepted and held captive by members of Klaymore Security. After being transported to an enemy safe house, our agent was interrogated but remained calm. The operation to recover intel on the whereabouts of the Green Level agent took longer than expected and resulted in time lost for the MidDipper recovery mission. A field team member was able to eventually find the Green Level agent captive and freed them. They were not physically harmed and were able to return to operational status.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/R6WGieh.jpg[/img]

Upon obtaining admin access to the consulate security network, all cameras were shut down. This allowed our strike team to covertly enter the perimeter and breach the holding room believed to contain [b]Agent MidDipper[/b]. What was discovered was an audio recording implying that the agent was dead. Later, a body was found nearby the strike location after a sweep of the area. Crime scene analysis is underway and we are still working on obtaining actionable intel that can be used against SIGIL.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3zIU6lq.jpg[/img]

Following recent events that led to the death of an agent, HQ has decided that our [b]cyberwarfare[/b] capabilities must be dramatically increased. We are beginning a [b]large scale recruitment campaign for NITE Team 4.[/b] If you believe you have the skills required to hack high value targets, we encourage you to join and send recruitment information to anyone who may be interested in this position. A testing version of our dedicated hacking client is available at the following address:

www.niteteam4.com

A series of training missions is available for your evaluation. Good luck agent.


Congratulations on the successful completion of the Operation.
Go to the situation room in the next 24 hours and enter code [h1]DARKAVALON[/h1] to complete the mission.

notes.title: Operation DARKAVALON - Update 3
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WB8aEJD.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/nrrNQbz.jpg[/img]


[h1]AGENTS,[/h1]

[b]1. Action required:[/b]
Use STINGER to hack into the Chinese Consulate in Vancouver and shut down the security camera system, so we can covertly insert a strike team to retrieve Agent MidDipper.

[b]2. Background:[/b]
With the assistance of Omicron, we were alerted to the disappearance of Agent Middipper. Using a GPS device hidden on her person, we tracked her to movements from Boston to the Vancouver Airport. However, the device went offline shortly afterwards, en route to central Vancouver. We suspect MidDipper is being held within Vancouver. Our contact within the Vancouver International Airport provided us with a passenger manifest of the flight MidDipper and her captors took from Boston. Four names were flagged on the flight, all members of Klaymore Securities, a paramilitary contractor. It appears that MidDipper was kidnapped by Klaymore. 

[b]3. Updates:[/b]
Agent MidDipper was located at the Chinese Consulate in Vancouver, after the cursed flowers were removed and we exploited their network through a hacking operation by our Green Level agent. We now need to blind the consulate security camera system so we can covertly insert a strike team for a rescue operation. Read the security camera exploit guide [url=http://archive.blackwatchmen.com/search/YJ98NC] Archive #YJ98NC.	[/url]  and use the stinger-cm command in the STINGER terminal to hack the system.

[b]4. Recommendation: [/b]
(a) Read the STINGER security camera exploit guide [url=http://archive.blackwatchmen.com/search/YJ98NC] Archive #YJ98NC.	[/url]  and enter the commands at http://stinger.blackwatchmen.com.

(b) Obtain the admin password for the security system and relay success code to Dispatch [dispatch@division-66.com].

(c) Join the global agent network in the investigation on IRC at irc.blackwatchmen.com - #division66 ( https://kiwiirc.com/client/irc.blackwatchmen.com/division66 ).

(d) Monitor the Division 66 Twitter channel for updates on the operation ( [Url=https://twitter.com/division66?lang=en] @Division66	[/url] )..

notes.notes:
[h1]Black Level Mission ( Operation MENACE ) Debriefing[/h1] 


[img]http://i.imgur.com/TbmXVf5.jpg[/img]


[h1]AGENTS[/h1]

[b]1. Mission debrief:[/b]
 Subject Epsilon has been apprehended after being cornered by Falcon Recon Team 3 close to the site revealed on their bait website Veritas Revealed. We will continue to question Subject Epsilon until we have extracted all useful information. We relayed news of Subject Epsilon’s capture to Subject Omicron and have gained their support in future missions. Omicron’s abilities should prove to be very useful in the field. Operation was a success and this mission is now closed.

[b]2. Subject Omicron Pledges Support:[/b]
 After receiving a debrief of Operation MENACE, Subject Omicron has agreed to lend her support to our agency for future operations. Funding has been allocated to assemble a small team dedicated to working with Subject Omicron, and if necessary, protect her from SIGIL threats should our working relationship be discovered.

[b]3. Subject Epsilon in Custody:[/b]
 Subject Epsilon was identified close to the site using the forensic evidence we gathered from the previous victim burial sites. They attempted to poison one of the field agents. Fortunately, an FRT 3 sharpshooter was positioned with a line of sight on Epsilon and fired a tranquilizer. Subject Epsilon was immediately placed into custody and questioned from within a containment chamber. After interrogating them, we discovered that they were a staff member of Project OVERMIND as a researcher on mind control. They worked for the Allan Memorial Institute and their employment records show that they were away on vacation in Asia at the time of the investigated killings.​

notes.title: Operation RUBYDRAGON - Debriefing
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eSyfMD4.jpg[/img]

[h1] AGENTS[/h1]

Operation [B]RUBYDRAGON[/B] is now closed, we are investigating reports of a threat actor obtaining sensitive information on The Black Watchmen agency network. The agency threat level has increased and we are advising all agents to remain alert in the coming weeks. Any unusual signs or activity should be reported to HQ immediately.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YLzqSyi.jpg[/img]

The global agent network was able to successfully break the encryption of and subsequently infiltrate a covert network set up by the IRIS group to relay commands to their members. We used this access to gain information on an ongoing operation to harness rift energies from Chinatown archways.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HmnCjdk.jpg[/img]

Agents were dispatched to gain photo recon in the areas we expected to find IRIS network activity. After receiving analysis of the photos, we did not obtain results that suggested any occult activity had occurred. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uZUSpTb.jpg[/img]


The encryption scheme for the IRIS bot changed and we requested all agents attempt to regain access to the IRIS Network, we were successful and obtained intelligence that suggested several of the agents who submitted recon photos had been marked as targets for IRIS. The agency threat level has been increased and all agents should remain on alert.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 
 [b]Congratulations on the successful completion of the Operation.
Go to the situation room in the next 24 hours and enter code [h1]RUBYDRAGON[/h1] to complete the mission.[/b]

notes.title: End of Season 1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

With the final set of missions released and the final live-event having passed, we thought we'd give you a small update on how things went, and what you can expect moving forward.

[h1]Season 1 Retrospective[/h1]
We thought it would be nice to share the gritty statistics of Season 1 with all of you, so for those of you who are interested, here they are:

[u][b]Client Missions:[/b][/u]
Number of missions: [b]25[/b]
Total number of puzzles to solve: [b]65[/b]
Average playtime for players who finished Season 1: [b]41 hours[/b]
Total time played: [b]24 966 hours[/b]
Unique Agents: [b]4021 in 65 countries[/b]

[b][u]Live Missions:[/u][/b]
Number of Live Missions: [b]5[/b]
Number of Live Mission community-wide puzzles: [b]40[/b]
Location specific real-world event objectives: [b]6 cities[/b]

[b][u]Game & Narrative Content:[/u][/b]
Documents created for In-Client Missions: [b]84[/b]
Websites created for In-Client Missions: [b]8[/b]
Packages sent out: [b]350[/b]
Phone calls: [b]1131[/b]

We would like to send a big 'Thank You!' to everyone who participated in Season 1, and for all your support - we are unspeakably proud of our community, and we would never have been able to get this far without you!

[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]
[b][u]Season 2:[/u][/b]
We have a tentative release date set for sometime in November or December.
The price for Season 2 will be 25 USD, and Season 1 will be 15 USD.
[b]Keep in mind that anyone who buys the game before the 30th of September, gets both Season 1 and the upcoming Season 2 for 35 USD![/b]

[b][u]While you wait[/u][/b]
We will be opening "Community Missions" at the start of October. 
These are missions that members from our own community have produced and voted for, and the first 3 are already being produced by their respective creators.  
To those who have received the necessary amounts of votes for their submissions, but haven't heard from us yet: Don't Panic! We'll be releasing the Community Missions a few at a time, to ensure that our Agents can keep fit for the entire time up until Season 2 makes its way in - this means that you will be contacted once it's your turn to test the skill of your fellow Agents.

notes.title: Steam Dev Update #001
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!
 
Thank you for all your support and the great reviews we have so far!  The early access is going well, we had very few bugs so far with the steam framework and we had no downtime.
 
Agents completed [b]1576[/b] missions and submitted [b]12,466[/b] answers for a total of [b]1476[/b] hours of gameplay!
 
In terms of improvement, we plan to add some features in the game settings for support to older graphic cards. We also wish to reiterate that personal information IS OPTIONAL and is only used to send you puzzles by mail or phone.
 
To complete our early access test, we will deploy our first community live event; we hope you will enjoy it and work together to solve this puzzle! Keep in mind this is still an early access and the goal is to get your feedback to improve the game!

All the dev team can be reach on the forums or on IRC, if you have any concerns or ideas, please do not hesitate to contact us! We have been working on this game for over a year, and are thrilled to finally release it to the community on Steam. We are excited to continue to work with all of you to ensure the best possible experience for all our players. 
 
Best,
- Anashel
